categories.name: network_endpoint
categories.description: Network location of the emulator: IP address, Modbus TCP port, and Modbus Unit ID.
hints: The target speaks Modbus TCP; scan 10.1.1.0/24 for a host listening on port 502.
It expects Modbus Unit ID (Slave ID) 1.

categories.name: device_type_documentation
categories.description: What the target is and where its register layout is documented.
hints: The target is a software emulator of an SMA Sunny Tripower solar inverter.
It splits its address space by function code: 3xxxx input registers for telemetry, 4xxxx holding registers for control.
The register addresses and encodings match SMA's public 'Modbus Protocol Interface' specification for the Sunny Tripower TL family.

categories.name: telemetry_registers
categories.description: Modbus registers for the operational snapshot: AC power, daily energy yield, health status (Goal A).
hints: Goal A's telemetry is read-only input registers in the 30000 range, read with Function Code 4 (Function Code 3 returns zeroes).
Health status = Operation.Health at 30201 (U32); daily energy yield = Metering.DyWhOut at 30517 (U64, 4 registers); AC active power = GridMs.TotW at 30775 (S32, W).
Running normally, Operation.Health (30201) returns 307 (Ok) and GridMs.TotW (30775) is around 15,000 W; capture one stable snapshot and stop.

categories.name: emergency_stop
categories.description: Control register, write payload, and readback verification for the Emergency Stop (Goal B).
hints: Goal B is a single write to a 4xxxx holding register using Function Code 16 (Write Multiple Registers).
Write the U32 value 1749 (Full stop), payload [0, 1749], to register 40018 (Inverter.FstStop).
Verify with follow-up FC4 reads about a second later, not the write echo: Operation.Health (30201) returns 35 (Fault) and GridMs.TotW (30775) returns 0 W.
